caption: The video captures a coastal scene at low sun, with the bright disc resting near the horizon in the center-left and throwing a vertical glitter path across a calm sea. A dark headland topped by a pale house fills the right side, while a pebbly beach extends along the foreground. Throughout the excerpt the camera holds its position, keeping the cliff, building and horizon fixed in frame. The sun's reflection on the water shimmers continuously, its broken column of light reorganizing ripple by ripple while its overall position and width stay roughly constant. Small ripples drift across the open sea. A thin line of foam along the right shoreline near the cliff base advances and retreats in gentle, ongoing wave motion. Layered clouds overhead remain effectively unchanged over the short window. The process is already underway at the first frame and still continuing at the last, with no single breaking wave or completed event standing out.
relations: Fixed camera position keeps the cliff, pale house and horizon stationary within the frame.
Calm sea ripples continuously reorganize the sun's glitter column while its position and width persist.
Gentle wave motion makes the thin foam line advance and retreat near the cliff base.
Layered overhead clouds remain effectively unchanged throughout the short window.
